export_gemma_to_executorch: run optimum-cli to export a Gemma model to ExecuTorch format with xnnpack recipe and quantization
load_gemma_executorch_model: load a Gemma model from HuggingFace using ExecuTorchModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained with custom_sdpa and quantization
generate_text_gemma_executorch: generate text with a loaded ExecuTorch Gemma model using the text_generation method and a tokenizer
load_gemma_portable_executorch: load a Gemma model using ExecuTorchModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained with the portable recipe for text generation
test_gemma_executorch_integration: run the ExecuTorchModelIntegrationTest suite to verify Gemma model export and text generation with ExecuTorch
